title: In a cloud session the default `merge --review-record` says to post the lines through the GitHub tool, then --read-back, and exits non-zero until read back
why: Today the default run exits 0 and says "nothing was posted"; under `verdict` that reads as PASS, so a record can look posted when it is not.
source: Coordinator 14:45 CST Nov 13, from lane review-record-readback (#3235), measured 19:58 UTC.
note: Filed 14:20 CST Nov 13 as the coordinator's candidate; triage judges it worth it: the same false PASS caused the hand-posts on #3226 and #3192 (page item 762). Measure (lane's, unread by triage): on main's tool a default run exits 0 and prints "nothing was posted"; #3235 keeps exit 0 on the default run, and only `--post` and `--read-back` give a verdict that means posted or confirmed; `--post` is refused in cloud, so cloud lanes hand-post through the MCP.
